Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
一天，很久很久以前，孟子和他妈妈住在中国。孟子妈妈的工作是祭拜，孟子不高兴，因为他说我们老是搬家，为什么？他妈妈说，从早到晚，我一直祭拜，很多墓地得我祭拜。所以我们得去很多不同的地方。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At “孟子不高兴,” add a physical sign of his feeling, such as “孟子皱着眉头，觉得很累。” This helps the reader see his frustration.
2. Before the mother explains her work, add a small action showing her mood, such as “妈妈叹了口气，说：‘从早到晚，我一直祭拜。’” This makes the dialogue more vivid.
3. At “很多不同的地方,” add one concrete detail, such as “有的墓地在山边，有的墓地在城外。” This gives the travel a clearer picture.

The sigh adds a natural emotional action without changing the event.
The traditional tale has them living near a cemetery, not travelling among many graves in different places.
